PluginData.Author: CometWorks
PluginData.Tooltip: Makes Modular Encounters Systems spawn NPCs in separate pockets that a Magnetar cluster can partition
PluginData.Description: Patches Modular Encounters Systems (MES, Workshop 1521905890) at runtime, without shipping any MES code. MES spawns land only in the cores of Voronoi cells, with empty gap bands between the cores wider than the cluster's partition split distance, so each pocket of NPC grids forms its own partitions that a cluster can balance and take offline. Spawns are also refused where the NPC density, counted cluster-wide including offline partitions when the cluster publishes its census, is over the limit. The plugin checks the MES version and the instructions of the patched methods and stays inactive, with a Critical log line, when they differ from the reviewed ones.
